result:
I documented 12 repos this run and pushed all of them. They are web-press-simulator, diamond-driller, signal-snapshot, signal-snapshot-backend, topo-war, note-note-note, pajamastan-warrants, paycheck-hub, topo-wars, pancake-orange, hackercons-roulette, and hackercons-roulette-api.

I did not check the live sites afterward.

Each got a README, a changelog, and a publish job. I also updated the state and repo files. The profile in the sudosilo repo is rebuilt and pushed, and it leaves out the private repo. The control-troll commit is pushed with the notes.

Before pushing I checked how each repo deploys. The front end repos have a root index.html, so none needed a vercel.json. The pajamastan-warrants repo is a Docker backend with no GitHub deployment connected, so a docs push does not touch its live page.

About 80 backfills remain, so roughly seven more runs at 12 per run. Another 36 repos have new pushes since their last documented date. I did not check them this run.

I could reach every repo I tried. The private repos only show up in a separate list query, so I merged the two lists to get their push times.
